cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(color_entry_characters C)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_C_EXTENSIONS OFF)
get_filename_component(source "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../.." ABSOLUTE)
if(NOT CUI_LIBRARY)
 message(FATAL_ERROR "Supply matching CUI_LIBRARY")
endif()
add_executable(test_color_entry_characters ${source}/tests/unit/test_color_entry_characters.c)
target_include_directories(test_color_entry_characters PRIVATE ${source}/include)
target_compile_options(test_color_entry_characters PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror -UNDEBUG)
target_link_libraries(test_color_entry_characters PRIVATE ${CUI_LIBRARY} m)
enable_testing()
add_test(NAME color_entry_characters COMMAND test_color_entry_characters)
